Photo 1 is a close-up of a label on a black plastic component. The label has a barcode and text including 'A272 070 18 JZ', '427 917 E211', and '22964'. The label is dirty and partially obscured.

Photo 2 shows a wider view of the same engine from a different angle, with a plastic bottle placed on top. The engine appears to be a V6 or inline-6, with a visible intake manifold and wiring harness. The floor is dirty, and the engine shows signs of wear and use.
